[[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst 4]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Holy Burst#Holy Burst|Holy Burst 4]]:''' This weapon sings of virtue, dealing 4d6 Good damage on a successful hit to Evil enemies, and 9d6 Good damage on a critical hit to Evil enemies. This effect makes the weapon good aligned.
Evil characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.
